meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以替你操作浏览器:打开网页、点击链接、填写表单、截图、保存 PDF,还能从页面提取文字或数据。它通过命令行工具一步步执行这些操作。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 打开网页、操作页面元素(点击、填表等)、截图或提取信息时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,截图保存到本地
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器打开页面并截图。

say.text: 在页面的搜索框里输入“AI 新闻”,然后点击搜索按钮
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框和按钮,依次执行输入和点击。

say.text: 提取当前页面所有链接的网址
say.note: Claude 会读取页面元素,返回链接列表。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can operate a browser for you: open pages, click links, fill forms, take screenshots, save PDFs, and extract text or data from pages. It runs these step by step via a command-line tool.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want Claude to open web pages, operate page elements (click, fill forms, etc.), take screenshots, or extract information.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a screenshot locally
say_en.note: Claude opens the page and takes a screenshot.

say_en.text: Type 'AI news' in the search box and click the search button
say_en.note: Claude locates the input and button, then performs the actions.

say_en.text: Extract all link URLs from the current page
say_en.note: Claude reads page elements and returns the list of links.
